import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    s = int(next(it)) - 1
    t = int(next(it))
    next_arr = [-1] * n
    while t % n != 0:
        if s < m:
            s += t % n
        else:
            s += n - (t % n)
        s %= n
        t -= 1
    cant = t // n
    prevs = s
    while cant > 0 and next_arr[s] == -1:
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < m:
                s += i
            else:
                s += n - i
            if s >= n:
                s -= n
        next_arr[prevs] = s
        prevs = s
        cant -= 1
    if cant > 0:
        cicle = 1
        prevs = s
        while next_arr[prevs] != s:
            cicle += 1
            prevs = next_arr[prevs]
        total = cant % cicle
        for _ in range(total):
            s = next_arr[s]
    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
